name: Raw
reference: Brutalist web design: default fonts, visible borders, tables and links, set with precision.
pattern: White, black and one link blue.
personality: Unpolished on purpose, exact in its spacing. Text appears in one frame.

motion.character: Hard cuts and one-frame appearances; a blinking cursor is the only constant motion.

grammar: Borders and tables are visible structure.
Text is left-aligned and unstyled beyond weight.
Links are underlined blue; nothing else is coloured.

pictures.note: Pictures as they are, in a bordered box like an image on a plain web page.

hits.note: No music. A plain click when something appears, if anything.

hook.how: A full page on frame 0: borders, the first line typing with its cursor, and under it what the page holds (a table, a list or a form, whichever the film has).

compose.how: A full page: the typed line and, under it, a table; the page's border round both (B.measure plus a pad), its middle on the optical centre. At 9:16 the page keeps to the low band's text-safe right edge. Never an empty page.

moves.move: Text types on with a block cursor at a human pace; the cursor is the only constant motion.

measurable.how: Text grows one character at a time while it types, and a cursor blinks at its end.

moves.move: Hard cuts and one-frame appearances; nothing tweens.

measurable.how: No element is at partial opacity on any frame.

moves.move: A page-down: the whole page jumps one screen in one frame.
Every edge sits on two verticals; the page is crude in style and exact in alignment.

measurable.how: No two edges sit 1-8 px apart.

props.role: "headline" for the line of the hook (the default label is for small print)

props.x: round its content: B.measure of the typed lines and the table, plus a pad; never an empty page

props.color: "accentText" for a link (the one blue), with an underline rule under it
props.role: "headline" (Raw's body is under the phone floor)

blocks.for: A link the viewer could follow: the only colour.
A plain click on a line end, at most six in 10 s.

props.label: the field's name
props.role: "headline" (Raw's body is under the phone floor)

blocks.for: A default form as a page ends: a ruled box with its name, the value typed at a human pace.

avoid.why: Raw is a page, not a poster.

ends.how: A default form or link the viewer can act on, the button pressed in one frame, then the name as a heading. Never a broken image.
ends.with: the name types as a heading (`cursor: true`) after the button press

mix.note: No music. Plain clicks only, at most six in 10 s, so the film is near silent.

shots.match: Pictures on one page share one light and one colour cast.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a personal homepage with no news
